facts_raw.Capital Type: Verified — Current Economics Not Publicly Disclosed
facts_raw.Funding / Support: HF0 currently states it backs 10 teams at a time; current official site does not publish the check size or equity terms.
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Not publicly disclosed on current official site
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Current official site does not publish investment/equity terms. Do not surface third-party $1M/5% figures as verified current terms.
facts_raw.Company Required at Application: Startup/team expected; exact incorporation requirement not publicly stated
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Repeat founders; no public nationality restriction stated on current site
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: HF0 publicly describes the program as 'the residency for repeat founders' and says it backs only 10 teams at a time.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site Required: Residency implies in-person; exact current residency schedule is not fully published on official site
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Current official site confirms a residency and current Demo Day (Dec 1) but does not publish a detailed attendance schedule.
facts_raw.Duration: Not publicly specified on current official site
facts_raw.International Founder: Not explicitly restricted on current site; practical US participation required
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Open application; current site lists Demo Day Dec 1
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Very early 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: high-signal program, but current deal economics are intentionally not published by HF0. Treat any $1M/5% figure only as historical/third-party, not a verified 2026 term.
